title: Make the scratch-entry lookup in note_engram_workspace_file_changes fail closed, and split the watcher-routing tests out of tests/engram_carried_checks.rs
outcome: An impossible miss of the per-directory scratch entry in note_engram_workspace_file_changes falls through to routing by the remembered key and fencing, never to `continue`. The scratch and watcher-routing tests move to their own test module, so tests/engram_carried_checks.rs is back under about 5,000 lines, as a pure move.
acceptance: The scratch-entry lookup binds the pushed or found entry once, or falls through to fencing on a miss; there is no `continue` on a miss.

only_the_scratch_directory_at_its_own_worktree_root_is_scratch, a_scratch_write_under_tmp…, and the two a_fixture_store_under_a… tests live in a dedicated module with a provenance header, moved without behaviour change, and they pass.
